name: Flamebrand
Effect: Adds 15-25 fire damage to attacks, chance to ignite targets
Description: The weapon glows with an inner heat, embers dancing along its edge. The air shimmers around it.

name: Frostbite
Effect: Adds 12-20 ice damage, slows enemy by 30% for 3 seconds on hit
Description: A thin layer of frost coats the blade, releasing a faint mist with each swing.

name: Stormcaller
Effect: Adds 18-30 lightning damage, 10% chance to stun target for 1 second
Description: Arcs of electricity crackle along the weapon's surface, illuminating the wielder's face in blue-white flashes.

name: Venom Edge
Effect: Adds 8-12 poison damage per second for 5 seconds, stacks up to 3 times
Description: The blade drips with a sickly green substance that hisses against surfaces.

name: Holy Smite
Effect: Adds 20-35 holy damage, double damage to undead and demons
Description: Pure white light radiates from the weapon, casting no shadow. Undead recoil at its presence.

name: Shadowstrike
Effect: Adds 15-25 shadow damage, 20% critical strike chance from stealth
Description: Darkness clings to the weapon like a living thing, distorting the light around it.

name: Nature's Wrath
Effect: Adds 14-22 nature damage, vines briefly immobilize target on crit
Description: Living vines and thorns wrap around the weapon, blooming with small flowers when at rest.

name: Void Strike
Effect: Adds 25-40 void damage, ignores 25% of target's armor
Description: A swirling vortex of darkness surrounds the weapon, warping space itself around its edges.

name: Bloodthirst
Effect: Heals wielder for 12% of damage dealt
Description: The weapon pulses with a crimson glow, growing warmer with each wound it inflicts.

name: Thunderstrike
Effect: Attacks chain to 2 nearby enemies for 50% damage
Description: Each swing sends crackling bolts arcing between nearby foes, illuminating the battlefield.

name: Soulburn
Effect: Deals 30% bonus damage to enemies below 25% health
Description: Wraith-like tendrils reach out from the weapon toward wounded enemies.

name: Earthshaker
Effect: Heavy attacks create a shockwave, staggering enemies in a cone
Description: The weapon hums with seismic energy, causing nearby pebbles to tremble and rise.

name: Windcutter
Effect: Increases attack speed by 20%, projectiles move 40% faster
Description: The weapon leaves a trail of swirling air in its wake, barely visible but always present.

name: Arcane Edge
Effect: Attacks deal additional 10-18 arcane damage scaling with Intelligence
Description: Ethereal runes glow along the blade, shifting and rearranging with each swing.

name: Doombringer
Effect: Attacks apply Doom: target takes 5% increased damage from all sources for 10 seconds
Description: A faint whisper follows each strike, and those struck feel a cold certainty of their demise.

name: Radiance
Effect: Deals 10-20 holy damage, heals allies within 5m for 3% of damage
Description: The weapon radiates warm golden light, and wounds close faintly in its presence.

name: Frostbrand
Effect: Critical hits freeze targets for 2 seconds and deal 40 bonus ice damage
Description: Jagged ice crystals form along the blade's edge, cracking and reforming constantly.

name: Soulreaper
Effect: Killing an enemy restores 8% max mana and grants 10% damage for 5 seconds
Description: Shadowy wisps flow from slain enemies into the weapon, which pulses with consumed life force.

name: Berserker's Fury
Effect: Damage increases by 2% for each 10% health missing (max +20%)
Description: The weapon glows brighter red as the wielder's wounds deepen, hungry for more combat.

name: Dragonbreath
Effect: Active ability: Exhale fire in a cone dealing 50-80 fire damage (30s cooldown)
Description: The weapon bears the sigil of an ancient dragon. When activated, flames erupt from the wielder's throat.

name: Voidrend
Effect: Attacks tear rifts in reality, dealing 20-35 void damage in a small area
Description: Each swing parts the air with a visible tear, revealing glimpses of the void between worlds.

name: Light's Judgment
Effect: Every 5th attack calls down a pillar of light dealing 60-100 holy damage
Description: The weapon bears intricate golden engravings that glow brighter with each consecutive strike.

name: Stoneflesh
Effect: Reduces all physical damage taken by 8%
Description: The armor takes on a granite-like texture, absorbing impacts with a dull thud.

name: Flame Ward
Effect: Reduces fire damage taken by 40%, immune to burning
Description: A warm orange aura surrounds the armor, deflecting flames before they make contact.

name: Frost Mantle
Effect: Reduces ice damage taken by 40%, immune to slowing effects
Description: A thin layer of perpetually melting frost covers the armor, never quite freezing or thawing.

name: Thunder Shield
Effect: Reduces lightning damage taken by 40%, immune to stun from lightning
Description: Small arcs of electricity dance harmlessly across the armor's surface, grounding the wearer.

name: Thornmail
Effect: Reflects 15% of melee damage back to attackers
Description: Living thorns grow from the armor's surface, recoiling when touched and piercing any who strike.

name: Shadow Cloak
Effect: Increases dodge chance by 12%, grants 10% movement speed
Description: Shadows cling to the armor, making the wearer harder to focus on. Edges seem to blur.

name: Iron Resolve
Effect: Increases max health by 15%, health regeneration by 2 per second
Description: A warm golden glow suffuses the armor, making the wearer feel vitality surge through them.

name: Spellguard
Effect: Reduces all magic damage taken by 12%, dispels one debuff every 30 seconds
Description: Invisible runes orbit the armor, shimmering into view only when spells strike the wearer.

name: Phantom Plate
Effect: 8% chance to become intangible for 1 second when hit, avoiding all damage
Description: The armor occasionally flickers, becoming translucent before solidifying again.

name: Bulwark
Effect: Absorbs the first 50 damage taken every 10 seconds (recharges)
Description: A faint hexagonal barrier pattern appears on the armor's surface, absorbing blows.

name: Mithril Plating
Effect: Reduces enemy's armor penetration by 20%, increases own armor by 10%
Description: Shimmering silver plates reinforce the armor, gleaming with an otherworldly metallic sheen.

name: Dragon Scale
Effect: Reduces all damage by 10%, grants 20% fire resistance
Description: Overlapping scales of deep crimson form across the armor, warm to the touch and nearly indestructible.

name: Plaguebearer
Effect: Nearby enemies have their attack speed reduced by 10% and take 5 poison damage per second
Description: A sickly green mist seeps from the armor, causing weeds to wither in the wearer's footsteps.

name: Aegis of Light
Effect: Reduces undead and demon damage by 30%, grants immunity to fear
Description: Golden light emanates from within the armor, warding off evil and inspiring courage.

name: Adamantine Shell
Effect: No single hit can deal more than 15% of max health
Description: The armor appears to be made of an impossibly dense material, distorting light around it.

name: Titan's Guard
Effect: Reduces duration of stuns, slows, and roots by 50%
Description: The armor feels impossibly heavy, as if anchored to the earth itself by invisible chains.

name: Warden's Resolve
Effect: Regenerates 3% max health per second when out of combat
Description: Living moss grows in the armor's crevices, pulsing with a gentle green glow.

name: Fortune's Favor
Effect: Increases rare loot drop chance by 15%, critical strike chance by 5%
Description: A four-leaf clover motif appears on the accessory, shimmering with faint golden light.

name: Mage's Insight
Effect: Increases max mana by 20%, mana regeneration by 3 per second
Description: Blue light pulses through the accessory like a heartbeat, resonating with the wearer's magic.

name: Swiftfoot
Effect: Increases movement speed by 25%, dodge chance by 5%
Description: The accessory vibrates with restless energy, leaving faint afterimages when the wearer moves.

name: Arcane Amplifier
Effect: Increases spell damage and healing by 18%
Description: Crystalline formations on the accessory refract magical energy, amplifying its output.

name: Blood Pact
Effect: Heals for 5% of all damage dealt, but costs 2% max health to equip
Description: The accessory appears to be made of a blood-red gemstone that pulses in rhythm with the wearer's heart.

name: Void Walker
Effect: Grants a short-range teleport ability (15m range, 20s cooldown)
Description: The accessory warps the space around it, and those who look too long feel momentarily disoriented.

name: Berserker's Totem
Effect: Increases damage by 2% per 10% missing health, up to 25% bonus
Description: A carved bone totem that glows brighter as the wearer takes damage, humming with primal fury.

name: Scholar's Pendant
Effect: Increases experience gained by 12%, increases skill learning speed by 10%
Description: An ancient medallion inscribed with forgotten languages, warm to the touch and faintly humming.

name: Shadow Amulet
Effect: Reduces detection range by 30%, allows stealth in daylight
Description: A dark gemstone that seems to drink in light, making the wearer harder to perceive.

name: Elemental Conduit
Effect: All elemental damage increased by 15%, elemental resistance increased by 10%
Description: Four gems representing fire, ice, lightning, and nature orbit the accessory in a slow dance.

name: Immortal's Charm
Effect: Once per day, survive a killing blow with 1 health (3 minute cooldown after proc)
Description: An ancient coin bearing the image of a figure stepping between life and death, eternally suspended.

name: Soulbound
Effect: Item cannot be dropped, traded, or stolen; binds permanently to the wielder
Description: Ethereal chains link the item to the wielder's soul, visible only in moonlight.

name: Eternal Preservation
Effect: Item cannot be damaged or destroyed by any means
Description: The item takes on an unchanging quality, immune to wear, rust, or decay. Time seems irrelevant to it.

name: Adaptive Attunement
Effect: Item automatically attunes to the wielder's highest stat, granting +10% to that stat
Description: The item subtly shifts color and texture to match the wearer's dominant aura.

name: Echo of the Ancients
Effect: Grants access to one random spell from a past life once per day
Description: Faint whispers of forgotten languages emanate from the item, and those who listen hear echoes of ancient wisdom.

name: Chromatic Shift
Effect: Item visually adapts to blend with surroundings, granting +10% stealth
Description: The item's surface becomes iridescent, shifting colors like oil on water to match any environment.

name: Mana Well
Effect: Restores 5% max mana every 10 seconds while out of combat
Description: A faint blue glow pulses through the item, like a heartbeat of pure magical energy.

name: Mark of the Champion
Effect: Increases experience gained from all sources by 20%
Description: A golden laurel wreath emblem appears on the item, radiating a sense of accomplishment.

name: Temporal Stasis
Effect: Once per day, freeze time for 3 seconds (only the wielder can act)
Description: An hourglass motif appears on the item, with sand that flows in impossible directions.

name: Ethereal Link
Effect: Creates a pocket dimension storing up to 20 items, accessible from anywhere
Description: The item contains a hidden space that seems larger on the inside, accessible by speaking a command word.

name: Curse of Greed
Effect: Increases gold found by 30%, but reduces experience gained by 10%
Description: The item glints with a golden sheen that seems to attract coin and greed in equal measure.

name: Fate Weaver
Effect: Once per day, reroll any failed dice check or saving throw
Description: Invisible threads of fate seem to emanate from the item, connecting the wielder to destiny itself.
